notExercised: uninstall without an active package cache or external HTTP

limits: Native execution covered Linux arm64 with an OpenBKN 0.2.2 main build (bkn-backend-ee sha2d2a597, ontology-query-ee with bkn-foundry#3125, agent-retrieval sha2d466bc, sandbox 0.2.2 main eeffdb4, sample service 022-3be0e6b3 with bkn-samples#285); no native amd64 certification and no released vanilla 0.2.2.

Calculations and schedule rules are mounted functions run through Context Loader execute_tool in a managed interaction; the rule tools were also called through the toolbox proxy without an interaction, as the schedule Gantt calls them. The plan actions ran through get_action_info, execute_action and get_action_execution.
Writing plans needs the OpenBKN 0.2.2 sandbox deployment (BKN_BASE_URL, BKN_TOKEN, gateway allowed); uninstalling needs a sample service with bkn-samples#260.
Delaying a purchase order on the platform was not exercised; the confirmed plans turning short when their purchase is delayed is covered by the source tests on the same fixtures.
The Workshop app needs the professional edition (Workshop); a community edition platform installs the sample without it, which was not exercised here.

In the browser on 8081 (Studio main-ec26f35) both app pages completed their rule checks in both languages (not checked: 0), and scheduled demands' bars show the kit status and line name; dragging plans and applying a scenario in the app were not exercised.
Reference queries, functions and actions were checked through APIs; full model-question cards were not exercised.

Kit check through the toolbox proxy, measured in the sandbox, three runs each: one plan's detail 4.07–6.1 s, the 13 installed plans 3.55–3.56 s, 200 plans 5.59–6.08 s. Most of the remaining time is the knowledge-network read of the BOM and sandbox start-up.
